limitations: Canvas rendering (snake, food, grid) cannot be asserted; only DOM overlay, score and button text are observable.
Game-over timing depends on the game tick interval; the wall-collision check relies on the tick firing within the assertion polling window and may be flaky.
Arrow-key movement and direction changes are not directly observable in the DOM.
Score increments require eating randomly placed food, so score changes are not deterministically testable.
Synthetic keydown events are not trusted browser input; Space handling may differ from real keyboard behavior in some environments.
Pause/resume via Space toggling back to running is not asserted because the overlay title would revert to hidden state without a stable text target.

# Pixel Snake Game

A classic snake game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. Fully offline and responsive.

## How to Play

- Use **Arrow keys** to move the snake.
- Eat the yellow food to grow and increase your score.
- Avoid hitting the walls or your own tail.
- Press **Space** to pause/resume.
- Use the **Restart** button to start over.

## Features

- Start paused with instructions overlay.
- Score display and game-over screen.
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus, hover, and pressed states.
- Responsive layout from 360px wide.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.
